headline: Trump orders US agencies to rename AI as 'Super Intelligence'
summary: President Trump signed an executive order directing the US government to refer to AI as 'Super Intelligence' rather than 'artificial intelligence,' saying the term better captures the technology's promise and potential. He said his earlier claims that AI safety fears were a Democrat-made 'hoax' no longer apply now that AI has been renamed.
